tools.logo:
<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="64" height="64" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="CropFlow logo">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="cf" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#C4B5FD"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#6EE7B7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FBCFE8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cfInk" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0B0A0F"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1A1530"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- rounded app tile -->
  <rect width="64" height="64" rx="16" fill="url(#cf)"/>

  <!-- flow ribbon: soft echo trail behind the eyedropper -->
  <path d="M22 42 C 28 42, 28 32, 34 32 S 42 38, 42 32"
        fill="none" stroke="#6EE7B7" stroke-width="3"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
        opacity="0.35"/>
  <path d="M22 38 C 28 38, 28 26, 34 26 S 42 32, 42 26"
        fill="none" stroke="#6EE7B7" stroke-width="3"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- crop frame: four L-shaped corner brackets -->
  <path d="M20 24 V20 H24"
        fill="none" stroke="url(#cfInk)" stroke-width="2.4"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M44 24 V20 H40"
        fill="none" stroke="url(#cfInk)" stroke-width="2.4"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M20 40 V44 H24"
        fill="none" stroke="url(#cfInk)" stroke-width="2.4"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M44 40 V44 H40"
        fill="none" stroke="url(#cfInk)" stroke-width="2.4"
        stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- eyedropper: centred on the tile, no tip circle, rotated 45° -->
  <g transform="translate(32 32) rotate(-45) scale(0.45) translate(-32 -29)">

    <!-- bulb / squeezy top -->
    <path d="M32 12
             C 34.5 12, 36 13.8, 36 16
             V 20
             H 28
             V 16
             C 28 13.8, 29.5 12, 32 12 Z"
          fill="url(#cfInk)"/>

    <!-- collar -->
    <rect x="27" y="20" width="10" height="2.4" rx="1.2"
          fill="#6EE7B7"/>

    <!-- barrel -->
    <rect x="29" y="22.4" width="6" height="18" rx="1.6"
          fill="url(#cfInk)"/>

    <!-- highlight on barrel -->
    <rect x="30.2" y="23.6" width="1.2" height="16" rx="0.6"
          fill="#6EE7B7" opacity="0.55"/>

    <!-- tapered tip -->
    <path d="M30.6 40.4
             L 32 46
             L 33.4 40.4
             Z"
          fill="#6EE7B7"/>
  </g>
</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="64" height="64" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="PaperFlow logo">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="pf-bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#C4B5FD"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#6EE7B7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FBCFE8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pf-flow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6EE7B7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#C4B5FD"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="pf-clip">
      <rect x="14" y="10" width="36" height="44" rx="10"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- Rounded gradient square -->
  <rect width="64" height="64" rx="16" fill="url(#pf-bg)"/>

  <!-- Page silhouette with round corners -->
  <rect x="14" y="10" width="36" height="44" rx="10" fill="#0B0A0F"/>

  <!-- Flow lines: three rounded strokes that shift in length, suggesting motion -->
  <g clip-path="url(#pf-clip)">
    <rect x="20" y="22" width="20" height="2.8" rx="1.4" fill="url(#pf-flow)"/>
    <rect x="20" y="30" width="26" height="2.8" rx="1.4" fill="url(#pf-flow)"/>
    <rect x="20" y="38" width="16" height="2.8" rx="1.4" fill="url(#pf-flow)" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Convert indicator: two rounded dots suggesting output/flow -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="44" r="1.4" fill="#6EE7B7"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="44" r="1.4" fill="#6EE7B7" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
